0029.enforcement_changes: The Campaign's declared limits stopped being declarations. Turns, input tokens, output tokens and the rollout timeout are compiled into the evaluation, the derived total ceiling with them, and the spending maximum is a pre-run precondition; a child-local supervisor bounds each variant at the founder-predeclared 3600 seconds and tears its containers down when its parent is lost. Two declared values moved by formulas decision 0029 predeclared: the per-episode output ceiling 8000 → 16000, and the comparison maximum $1.00 → $2.50 against a computed bound of $2.42.
0029.evidence: Four canonical runs were executed against Campaign ad393bc0 — two baseline-vs-v1 stability comparisons, one baseline-vs-reference comparison, and one v1-vs-frozen-v2 comparison — every proof verifying offline, no episode of the 288 reaching any enforced limit and no variant reaching the supervisor deadline. The orphan bound is evidenced by a real worker-SIGKILL injection in which both supervision records read parent_lost and all four recorded containers were gone 0.545 s after the kill.
